$comment: Cut-out rig for the Inspyry characters, in each SVG's own viewBox units (measured with a grid render). `pnpm --filter @banyan/video rig` writes <id>.head.svg (headPoly, extended `neck` units down so the seam stays covered when the head turns) and <id>.body.svg (everything outside headPoly). The head pivots at `pivot`; blinks draw eyelids over `eyes`. `viewBox` must match the SVG (the rig script checks it).
